title: Payment
subtitle: 「付款／結算／已付金額／交易／匯款」，究竟是哪一種 payment？
description: 「付款／結算／已付金額／交易／匯款」，究竟是哪一種 payment？

words.note: 使用者提供。當 payment 指把欠款、帳單、索償或交易金額正式付清／了結時，settlement 很自然。它常帶『把未清責任結束掉』的意味。
words.example: Settlement of the invoice is due within thirty days.

exercises.original: Payment of the outstanding invoice must be made by Friday.
exercises.zh: 未清發票必須在星期五前付款結清。
exercises.upgrade: settlement · 結算；清償；付款了結

options.explanation: outstanding invoice 表示一筆尚未清償的款項，settlement 強調把債務正式了結。
指完整金融／商業操作，範圍比 payment 更廣。 transaction 只表示一宗金融事件，沒有『把 outstanding account 正式清償』的意思。
只聚焦實際支付了多少錢，是一個數額概念。 amount paid 只回答付了多少，不能表達 invoice/claim 被了結。
強調把款項匯給收款人，常見於銀行、跨境與供應商付款。 remittance 強調把錢送給對方；題目核心是債務或索償被清償。
強調資金在帳戶之間移動，不一定代表購買或清償。 transfer 只說資金移動方式，不保證責任已全部清掉。
正式表示機構、基金或貸款把資金支付／發放出去。 disbursement 是付款方把資金發放出去的會計視角，不等於清償一筆 outstanding obligation。

exercises.original: The parties agreed on payment of the claim without going to court.
exercises.zh: 雙方同意在不上法庭的情況下完成索償款項的結算。
exercises.upgrade: settlement · 結算；清償；付款了結

exercises.original: Full payment of the account is required before the goods are released.
exercises.zh: 貨物放行前必須把帳戶欠款全數結清。
exercises.upgrade: settlement · 結算；清償；付款了結

words.meaning: 已付款金額；實際支付數額
words.note: 使用者提供。最透明地表示實際支付了多少錢，重點是數額，不是付款行為、付款方式或整個交易。
words.example: The receipt shows the amount paid and the remaining balance.

exercises.original: The receipt lists the payment beside the tax and total balance.
exercises.zh: 收據在稅項和總結餘旁列出已付款金額。
exercises.upgrade: amount paid · 已付款金額；實際支付數額

options.explanation: receipt 上的欄位是在記錄具體數額，因此 amount paid 比 transaction 或 remittance 更準確。
強調把欠款、發票、索償或未清責任正式付清／了結。 settlement 側重清償行為；題目要比較 receipt/refund/statement 上的具體數值。
指完整金融／商業操作，範圍比 payment 更廣。 transaction 是事件，不是數值欄位。
常指保險、獎金、投資等一次性支付給收款人的金額。 payout 常帶保險、獎金或一次性收益語感；題目只是一般已付金額。
指分期付款中的其中一期或一系列分期。 instalment 必須是分期中的一期；題目沒有分期安排。
把某人已先支付的費用補回，通常需要 expense/receipt/claim。 reimbursement 要有先墊付後補回；題目只問原先實際支付多少。

exercises.original: The refund cannot exceed the original payment made by the customer.
exercises.zh: 退款不得超過顧客原先實際支付的金額。
exercises.upgrade: amount paid · 已付款金額；實際支付數額

options.explanation: 這裡需要比較 refund 與原始數值上限，重點是 money amount。

exercises.zh: 請核對帳單上顯示的已付款金額是否與你的紀錄一致。
exercises.upgrade: amount paid · 已付款金額；實際支付數額

words.example: The bank flagged the transaction for additional checks.

exercises.original: The bank blocked the payment because it appeared unusual.
exercises.zh: 銀行因該宗付款看來異常而阻止交易。
exercises.upgrade: transaction · 交易；付款交易

options.explanation: bank monitoring 的對象是一宗系統記錄的 financial event，transaction 比 amount paid 更自然。
強調把欠款、發票、索償或未清責任正式付清／了結。 settlement 要有欠款／索償被了結；銀行系統只是記錄一宗事件。
強調資金在帳戶之間移動，不一定代表購買或清償。 transfer 要有 account-to-account movement；題目可以是 card payment 或一般 account history。
強調把款項匯給收款人，常見於銀行、跨境與供應商付款。 remittance 強調把款項匯送出去；題目重點是系統中的一宗記錄。
只聚焦實際支付了多少錢，是一個數額概念。 amount paid 是數額，不是可被 bank block 或 assign reference number 的 event。
正式表示機構、基金或貸款把資金支付／發放出去。 disbursement 是機構支付出去的資金，範圍比一般 card/account transaction 窄。

exercises.original: Each payment receives a unique reference number in the card system.
exercises.zh: 每宗付款交易在信用卡系統中都有獨一無二的參考編號。
exercises.upgrade: transaction · 交易；付款交易

exercises.original: The app displays every payment made with the account during the month.
exercises.zh: 應用程式顯示該帳戶本月的每宗交易。
exercises.upgrade: transaction · 交易；付款交易

words.note: 較正式，指把錢匯給另一人、機構或地區，常見於跨境匯款、帳單付款、移工匯款與銀行語境。重點是『把款項送出去』。
words.example: The supplier confirmed receipt of the remittance.

exercises.original: The payment was sent overseas to the worker's family through a bank transfer service.
exercises.zh: 款項透過銀行轉帳服務匯往海外給該工人的家人。
exercises.upgrade: remittance · 匯款；匯寄款項

options.explanation: overseas + family + money sent 是典型 remittance 語境。
強調資金在帳戶之間移動，不一定代表購買或清償。 transfer 更中性地說帳戶資金移動；題目有 overseas/supplier/international sent-to-recipient 的匯款語義。
指完整金融／商業操作，範圍比 payment 更廣。 transaction 太廣，不能突出 money being sent to a recipient。

正式表示機構、基金或貸款把資金支付／發放出去。 disbursement 偏機構／基金發放；家庭匯款或供應商匯款更自然用 remittance。

exercises.original: Please include the invoice number with your payment to the supplier.
exercises.zh: 向供應商匯款時請附上發票號碼。

exercises.original: The bank charges a small fee for each international payment sent abroad.
exercises.zh: 銀行對每筆國際匯款收取少量手續費。

words.example: The transfer should reach your account within one working day.

exercises.original: I made the payment directly from my bank account to yours.
exercises.zh: 我直接從我的銀行帳戶轉帳到你的帳戶。

words.meaning: 撥款；支付出去的款項；款項發放
words.note: 較正式、會計／行政用語，指機構、基金、政府、公司或受託方把款項支付出去。常見於 grants、loans、expenses、funds。
words.example: The first disbursement of grant funding will be made in April.

exercises.original: The first payment from the grant fund will be released next month.
exercises.zh: 補助基金的第一筆撥款將於下月發放。
exercises.upgrade: disbursement · 撥款；支付出去的款項；款項發放

options.explanation: grant fund + released 是正式款項發放語境，disbursement 最精確。
強調資金在帳戶之間移動，不一定代表購買或清償。 transfer 只描述資金移動；題目強調 grant/loan/project budget 的正式發放。

words.note: 常指保險賠償、獎金、投資退出、彩金或其他一次性支付出去的金額。語氣比 disbursement 更日常／商業化，重點常是收款人拿到的那筆錢。
words.example: The insurance payout covered most of the repair costs.

exercises.original: The insurance payment was enough to replace the damaged equipment.
exercises.zh: 保險賠付款足以更換受損設備。
exercises.upgrade: payout · 支付款；賠付款；派彩；一次性支付金額

options.explanation: insurance + amount received after loss 是典型 payout。

words.meaning: 報銷；償還費用；費用補回
words.note: 指某人先自行支付費用，之後由公司、保險、政府或另一方把該費用補回。它不是一般購物付款，而是repayment of an expense already incurred。
words.example: Employees can claim reimbursement for reasonable travel expenses.

exercises.original: Employees can request payment for travel costs they have already paid themselves.
exercises.zh: 員工可以申請補回自己已先支付的交通費。
exercises.upgrade: reimbursement · 報銷；償還費用；費用補回

options.explanation: already paid themselves 是 reimbursement 的決定性線索。
常指保險、獎金、投資等一次性支付給收款人的金額。 payout 可泛指保險賠款，但題目特別有 receipts/already paid/business expenses，重點是費用補回。

falseSynonyms.zh: settlement 常指把欠款、發票、索償或爭議正式了結；普通付款未必是 settlement。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Settlement of the invoice is due on Friday. The customer made a card payment.

falseSynonyms.zh: transaction 比 payment 更廣，可包括退款、提款、轉帳、購買等完整金融事件。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The bank reviewed the transaction. The merchant received the payment.

falseSynonyms.zh: amount paid 只表示實際支付的數額；payment 可以指付款行為、款項或支付方式。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The amount paid was £120. Payment is due within seven days.

falseSynonyms.zh: remittance 強調把款項匯送給收款人，常見於銀行、跨境與發票語境。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The supplier received the remittance. The customer made a cash payment.

falseSynonyms.zh: transfer 強調資金由一個帳戶移到另一帳戶；它不一定是購買或清償。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I made a bank transfer. The payment covered the invoice.

falseSynonyms.zh: instalment 只是總金額分期後的其中一期，不是所有付款。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The final instalment is due in June. The full payment is due today.

falseSynonyms.zh: reimbursement 是把別人先墊付的費用補回；普通付款沒有「先墊後還」條件。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Employees can claim reimbursement for travel costs. Customers must make payment before delivery.

falseSynonyms.zh: pay 通常作動詞表示付款，也可作名詞表示薪酬；payment 是名詞，表示付款、款項或支付行為。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Please pay the invoice today. Payment is due today.
